system.description: As a free action, spend up to (SL x 10) MP to become a visual duplicate of any creature for (1 + 1 per 10 MP spent) rounds. Anyone attacking a creature identical to you must randomly choose among all such identical creatures except itself. You may reveal yourself as a free action to end the effect.
